title: Airport strike - rebook in the next 10 minutes
scenario: During a real airport strike, a text with an airline logo says your flight is affected and you have 10 minutes to rebook through a link before all alternate seats are gone.

answers.A: Click the link and rebook quickly before seats run out.
answers.B: Click the link, and pay extra to guarantee priority rebooking.
answers.C: Go directly to the airline's official app or website to check your flight status and rebook there.

explanation: Real disruptions are exploited by scam texts that copy the logo and urgency of a genuine airline alert - the actual rebooking always happens on the airline's own channel.
proTip: A real disruption is confirmed on the airline's own app, not a text with a countdown.
